title: Classic ESP32 over the CH34x bridge (needs M2; serial-interleaving evidence)

setup.describe: Flash the classic firmware (uses the flash-fw-esp32v3 toolchain args but WITHOUT --monitor — the monitor would hold the port the browser needs)
setup.run: just build-fw-esp32v3 && espflash flash --chip esp32 --partition-table lp-fw/fw-esp32v3/partitions.csv --flash-size 4mb --after hard-reset --port {port} target/xtensa-esp32-none-elf/release-esp32v3/fw-esp32v3

manual: Open the printed Studio URL and Connect — the CH34x port should now APPEAR in the chooser (M2).
Let the card settle; parse-anomaly events here are evidence for the serial-interleaving defect.
Press Enter here to finish the capture.
